dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent over Banke District, Lumbini Province, Nepal as of 25 & 30 October 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20221117NPL** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Banke District, Lumbini Province, Nepal as observed from Sentinel-2 images acquired on 25 & 30 October 2022 (Cumulative). Within the analyzed area of about 4,000 km², a combined 33 km² of lands appear to be flooded on the 25th and the 30th of October 2022. Water extent appears to have decreased of about 26 km² since the 15th October 2022. Based on Worldpop population data and the detected surface waters, about 1,400 people are potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas, of which 1,400 are located in Duduwa and Narainapur Palikas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
